description: This file defines a Flow struct and associated methods for managing conversational flows within a Mattermost plugin, including HTTP initialization, step management, and state handling.

classes.name: Flow
classes.description: Represents a conversational flow with steps, state management, and HTTP handlers within a Mattermost plugin.

methods.name: NewFlow
methods.description: Creates a new Flow instance with configuration validation.

methods.name: WithSteps
methods.description: Adds ordered steps to the flow.

methods.name: OnDone
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked upon flow completion.

methods.name: InitHTTP
methods.description: Initializes HTTP routes for the flow.

methods.name: WithDebugLog
methods.description: Enables debug logging of the flow state.

methods.name: ForUser
methods.description: Creates a flow instance for a specific user.

methods.name: GetCurrentStep
methods.description: Retrieves the current step name in the flow.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the flow with an initial state.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Completes the flow and invokes the done callback.

methods.name: Go
methods.description: Transitions to a specified step, handling state updates and messaging.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next step name after a given step.
